# YorpHives

> YorpHives is an open capability network for people and AI agents. Discover useful capabilities, inspect their contracts, invoke them, and compose them into workflows.

## Canonical discovery
- Capability catalog: https://yorphives-2-preview.pages.dev/api/v1/capabilities
- Machine-readable manifest: https://yorphives-2-preview.pages.dev/.well-known/yorphives-capabilities.json
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://yorphives-2-preview.pages.dev/openapi.json
- MCP Streamable HTTP: https://yorphives-2-preview.pages.dev/api/mcp

## Execution
POST https://yorphives-2-preview.pages.dev/api/v1/execute
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "capability": "text.analyze",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "input": { "text": "Text to analyze" }
}

## Current public capability
- text.analyze@1.0.0 — deterministic text metrics and frequent terms.
- Pricing: free.
- Authentication: none.
- Input: plain text, maximum 20,000 characters.
- Retention: none; execution is in-memory.
- External side effects: none.

## MCP
- Endpoint: https://yorphives-2-preview.pages.dev/api/mcp
- Transport: Streamable HTTP
- Tool: text_analyze
- Discover tools with tools/list before invocation.

## Trust and safety
- Read the catalog before executing a capability.
- Do not send secrets or sensitive personal data to public capabilities.
- Pricing, authorization, limits, and data handling are declared in capability metadata.
- Errors use structured machine-readable codes and request IDs.

## Status
Early foundation. Capabilities marked available are implemented in the current deployment; roadmap items are not executable until explicitly published in the catalog.

## Identity and authorization
- Bearer credentials are issued per principal and stored as SHA-256 hashes.
- Principals are distinct from API keys; key scopes are limited and revocable.
- Provisioning requires the operator-only `YH_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET`.
- Capability grants can impose daily execution and spending ceilings.

## Usage and commerce
- Usage: `GET /api/v1/usage` (scope: `usage:read`).
- Credits: `GET /api/v1/commerce/credits` (scope: `credits:read`).
- Checkout: `POST /api/v1/commerce/checkout` (scope: `commerce:checkout`, server-configured pack IDs only).
- Stripe webhooks: `POST /api/webhooks/stripe`; credits are only issued after signature and order validation.
- Operator reconciliation: `POST /api/v1/commerce/reconcile`; requires a separate secret.
- Do not assume paid execution is enabled. Payment secrets and credit packs must be configured separately.

## Operational status
- Health: `GET /api/v1/health`.
- The append-only usage, credit, payment-event, and audit ledgers are stored in the isolated preview D1 database.
